y25169ae4c10.add: - **Population and forest cover:** forest loss is usually linked to population pressure (an A–R key treats it as the demographic-transition effect), but ISFR shows forest cover **rising** from ~19% (1999–2003) to **21.76% (2023)** while population grew.

y84d58670acb.add: - **Lichens** (alga + fungus) – pioneers on bare rock, alpine and tundra surfaces; the **litmus** dye is extracted from **lichens** – not from palash ('flame of the forest') flowers or indigo leaves.

y51dca5ea0b3.add: - **Ginkgo biloba** (maidenhair tree) – gymnosperm called a **living fossil** (sole survivor of Ginkgophyta; cycads are also called living fossils) – not Pinus, Cedrus deodara or Ephedra.
